purpose: Complete Wave E's scenario-comparator layer with one current-policy continuation reference case and one mechanically adverse measurement-boundary stress case for every lane. The packs validate component coverage and floor comparison behavior without asserting reform effects, fiscal scores, target costs, savings, rates, or policy recommendations.
